description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling Git object IDs (OIDs) in the libgit2 library, including parsing, formatting, copying, comparing, and shortening OIDs.

methods.name: git_oid_fromstr
methods.description: Parses a hex formatted object id string into a git_oid structure.

methods.name: git_oid_fromstrp
methods.description: Parses a null-terminated hex string into a git_oid structure.

methods.name: git_oid_fromstrn
methods.description: Parses N characters of a hex formatted object id into a git_oid.

methods.name: git_oid_fromraw
methods.description: Copies raw bytes into a git_oid structure.

methods.name: git_oid_fmt
methods.description: Formats a git_oid into a hex string.

methods.name: git_oid_nfmt
methods.description: Formats a git_oid into a partial hex string.

methods.name: git_oid_pathfmt
methods.description: Formats a git_oid into a loose-object path string.

methods.name: git_oid_tostr_s
methods.description: Returns a static string representation of a git_oid.

methods.name: git_oid_tostr
methods.description: Formats a git_oid into a buffer as a hex string.

methods.name: git_oid_equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two git_oid structures.

methods.name: git_oid_ncmp
methods.description: Compares the first 'len' hex characters of two git_oid structures.

methods.name: git_oid_streq
methods.description: Checks if a git_oid matches a hex string.

methods.name: git_oid_strcmp
methods.description: Compares a git_oid to a hex string.

methods.name: git_oid_iszero
methods.description: Checks if a git_oid is all zeros.

methods.name: git_oid_shorten_add
methods.description: Adds an OID to the set for shortening.
